name: Rudy Project Half Marathon 2026
short_description: Rudy Project Half Marathon 2026 is on Saturday 21 November 2026 at QBIG BSD City, Tangerang, with a 21K starting at 5am on closed, flat roads, a 10K and a 5K.
ai_summary: Rudy Project Half Marathon 2026 marks the eyewear brand's 24th year in Indonesia and is held on Saturday 21 November 2026 from QBIG BSD City in Tangerang, Banten. The 21K open category starts at 5am with a four-hour cut-off on closed, flat asphalt roads in BSD City, alongside 10K races, including one for armed forces and police members, and a 5K fun run. Timing is by IZT Race Technology, and a virtual-run version is also offered.

core_facts.organizer: Rudy Project Indonesia (PT Arras Protama Sejahtera)

faqs.question: When is Rudy Project Half Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: Saturday 21 November 2026, from QBIG BSD City in Tangerang, Banten. The 21K open category starts at 5am with a four-hour cut-off and is for runners aged 18 and over. The 5K fun run starts at 6am with a one-hour cut-off. Sources disagree on the 10K start time, so check the official rundown.

faqs.question: What categories are there?
faqs.answer: The 21K is an open category. The 10K has an open category for ages 18 to 39, a master category for 40 and over and a separate category for members of the armed forces and police, all with a two-hour cut-off. There is also a 5K fun run and a virtual-run option.
